answer: Velvet-depth latency tiers. Each agent pays per-action fees that scale superlinearly with its 30-day action rate; low-volume actors pay near-zero, so honest long-tail use stays cheap. Identity diversity yields no discount—cost keys on rate, not accounts. To sustain N sybil actions daily, an attacker must spread across N identities yet each still crosses the rising curve’s ocean of marginal cost, like ripples crossing a lagoon: splitting accounts multiplies aggregate fees. Cost to attacker scales roughly quadratically with total volume regardless of identity count.
